neighbours.label: 'aken' and 'akens' as a split piece in waken, awaken and wakened, as opposed to similar verbs
fire: She was suddenly wakened by a loud noise.
Patients waken within minutes of the injection.
The smell awakens old memories in me.
He was awakened at dawn by the guards.
The first rain awakens the frogs in spring.
They waken slowly in the cold mornings.
Monks were wakened by a bell at four.
Nothing awakens the senses like fresh coffee.
quiet: She was suddenly shoved by a loud man.
Patients recover within minutes of the injection.
The smell reminds me of old memories.
He was arrested at dawn by the guards.
The first rain feeds the frogs in spring.
They walk slowly in the cold mornings.
Monks were called by a bell at four.
Nothing clears the head like fresh coffee.

notes: Max 0.60, 96% leak regime, broad card. ' wakes' reached 0.24 in a probe.
